text: March animals feed you as well as the Overworld's do. Their meat is **Raw Game**, and their hides give **March Leather**.
Roast Game is as filling as a steak, which makes long trips through the March much easier.

**Raw Game** comes from Ash Hopper, Bouldersnout, Chime Grazer, Cinderhide, Crag Bounder, Cragcoat, Dawn Stag, Driftpelt, Fen Strider, Frost Strider, Lantern Fox, Longshank, Loom Swift, March Walker, Marsh Hopper, Mossback, Palewing, Prism Grazer, Ridge Grazer and Tuftback.

**March Leather** comes from Bouldersnout, Chime Grazer, Cinderhide, Crag Bounder, Crag Troll, Cragcoat, Dawn Stag, Deep Lurker, Driftpelt, Fen Strider, Frost Strider, Lantern Fox, Longshank, March Walker, Mossback, Prism Grazer, Reed Coil, Reed Stalker, Ridge Grazer, Rift Hound, Rime Troll, Slag Troll, Tuftback and Veil Ray.
Each creature's own page gives the counts.
Looting adds up to one more of each. An animal that dies burning drops its meat already roasted.
pages.title: Where it comes from

text: Raw Game restores **3** hunger and not much saturation. Roast Game restores **8** with high saturation.
Cook it in a furnace, a smoker (twice as fast) or on a campfire (slowest, but no fuel).
Both count as meat: wolves will eat them, and other mods treat them as raw or cooked meat.
pages.title: Cooking and eating

text: One March Leather crafts into one ordinary leather, so anything that asks for leather, like a Silent Drum, is only a crafting step away.
It also counts as leather for other mods that accept any leather.
pages.title: March Leather

pages.text: One March Leather makes one leather.
